name: Marriage Migration Visa
description: The F-6 visa is for foreign nationals married to Korean citizens. It provides long-term residence status and work authorization for spouses of Korean nationals.
tagline: Live in Korea with your Korean spouse
targetAudience: Those planning to marry Korean nationals
Families seeking to reunite in Korea

workPermission.notes: Full work authorization in any field

pathsTo.name: Residence Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Meet F-2 eligibility through marriage to Korean citizen. Extended residence and integration into Korean society required.
pathsTo.notes: F-6 holders can transition to F-2 for greater independence and as a stepping stone toward F-5 permanent residence or naturalization.
